name: Settings
description: Shows the settings page where you can enable or disable plugins and change some options. (Also manage Themes)

name: Never Go Idle
description: Never go in idle mode, no more message about you being idle on Teams.

name: Better Gifs
description: Swap from Giphy to Kiply which has better gifs and no restriction from Microslop.

name: Better App Bar
description: Allow you to choose what to display in the app bar (bar on the left of your screen).

name: Better Input Bar
description: Allow you to choose what to display in the input bar (bar on the bottom of your screen).

name: Startup User
description: Allow you to choose which user chat Teams will open on startup.

name: Custom Name
description: Allow you to change the name of people.

name: Copy Message
description: Allow you to copy messages easily.

name: Custom Emojis
description: Allow to upload custom emojis into Teams (people can see them).
